desc_id: Umbul Jumprit adalah mata air di lereng Gunung Sindoro. Airnya jernih dan tidak pernah kering, lalu mengalir menjadi hulu Sungai Progo. Setiap Waisak, air suci untuk perayaan di Candi Borobudur diambil dari sini.
desc_en: Umbul Jumprit is a spring on the slopes of Mount Sindoro. Its clear water never dries up and flows on to become the source of the Progo River. Every Vesak, holy water for the celebration at Borobudur Temple is taken from here.
